articles.summary: CARMEL, Ind., February 5, 2024 — MBX Biosciences, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing Precision Endocrine Peptide™ (PEP™) therapeutics to treat an array of endocrine disorders, today announced the appointment of Steven Ryder, M.D, Chief Medical Officer of Rallybio, to its Board of Directors.
